name: Shiki Senri
source: Senri Shiki is one of the youngest Night Class members and works as a model with Rima Tooya. He stands at 173 cm tall. Senri is usually the one sent out to hunt down a level E vampire. He is able to control and bend his blood at will. Senri's father is Rido Kuran, making him Kaname and Yuuki's cousin, and his mother's uncle is part of the council.
